title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.33299v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. translated_title: AquaWAM：面向水下具身智能体的动力学感知世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型（WAM）对于具身智能来说正变得越来越重要和有用，因为它们使机器人能够在与物理环境交互之前预测候选动作的后果。然而，水下机器人通常受到被动动力学的影响，例如惯性、浮力、流体动力阻力和持续漂移，这些因素即使在一个动作完成后仍会继续影响载体。现有的世界动作模型主要预测以动作为条件的视觉观测，并未被明确设计来捕捉这种被动运动动力学。在本文中，我们提出了 AquaWAM，这是第一个专为水下具身智能体设计的世界动作模型。AquaWAM 不预测未来图像，而是同时建模以动作为条件的物理动力学和被动物理动力学，包括推进器死区、超出每条指令仍持续存在的惯性滑行以及环境水流。具体而言，它通过 DVL（多普勒计程仪）进行感知……
tldr: AquaWAM 是首个专为水下具身智能体设计的世界动作模型，它不再预测未来图像，而是同时建模主动动作动力学与惯性滑行、推进器死区、环境水流等被动动力学，从而帮助水下机器人预测动作后果。
en_tdlr: AquaWAM is the first World Action Model for underwater embodied agents that, instead of predicting future images, models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics—such as inertial glide, thruster dead band, and ambient currents—to enable robots to anticipate action consequences underwater.
